table_attributes.Lookup Sql Override:
SELECT 
	PAY_PERIOD.PP_NUM as PP_NUM, 
	PAY_PERIOD.PP_END_YEAR as PP_END_YEAR, 
	PAY_PERIOD.CURR_PP_FLAG as CURR_PP_FLAG, 
	PAY_PERIOD.PP_START_DTE as PP_START_DTE, 
	PAY_PERIOD.PP_END_DTE as PP_END_DTE 
FROM 
	PAY_PERIOD
WHERE
	CURR_PP_FLAG = 'Y'

                       v_RECORD_TYPE_FLAG = 'H' AND
                        NOT IS_DATE(v_PSEUDO_DATE_STRING, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                                 ABORT('!!!! The value : ' || v_PSEUDO_DATE_STRING || ' is not a valid date'),

NULL)

table_attributes.Lookup Sql Override:
SELECT 
	COUNT(*) as COUNT_CURRENT 
FROM 
	ERROR_TBL a,

(SELECT 
    MAX(b1.ERROR_DATE) as ERROR_DATE
FROM 
    ERROR_TBL b1
WHERE
	b1.ERROR_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND
	b1.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_Pseudossn_Load_Pseudossn_Tbl'
AND
	SUBSTR(b1.ERROR_MESSAGE, 3, 9) = 'duplicate' ) b

WHERE 
	a.ERROR_DATE = b.ERROR_DATE
AND
	a.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_Pseudossn_Load_Pseudossn_Tbl'
